elements.name: street lamps as soft blurred glows

wrong_setting: Reads as a framed street view, like a TV screen or rounded picture frame, not the inside of a moving vehicle window; the street, cars and buildings are rendered as recognizable objects.
notes: Remove the rounded dark frame and paper margin so the painting runs edge to edge, blank out the garbled shop-sign lettering, and soften the street into abstract round bokeh glows with sideways stretch and faint glass reflections, so it reads as looking out of a moving vehicle window.
